integrity: The structural proof is independent of finite field experiments; the standalone standard-library checker reproduces enumerations and mod-p boundary ranks at p=2,3,5. The rook homology comparison is attributed to prior published work, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The dual wedge decomposition and integral homology of the original cut complex are established for the unique Shrikhande graph, not for arbitrary strongly regular graphs. The original cut-complex homotopy type and independent validation are not claimed. Incompleteness of searchable literature remains possible.
title: Ordinary three-cut homology distinguishes the Shrikhande graph from its rook mate
